text.content: Date: August 26, 2026 | Timezone: America/Toronto | Retrieved: 05:00 EDT | Audience: Trevor Longino. Freshness sweep completed first. Upstream source for the 06:00 GreenAI.studio dispatch.

Search families covered Qwen/model cards, Glimmer/Muse, abliterated and unrestricted derivatives, open-weight releases, local runtimes and serving, agent infrastructure, hardware/memory/power, policy/enterprise, arXiv efficiency papers, AI Engineer YouTube, GitHub/Hugging Face, and Hacker News/community discussions. Discovery pool: approximately 55 candidates across 20 search passes. Thesis-deduplicated pool: approximately 32. Scored shortlist: 9. Primary artifacts inspected: 6. Transcript-backed videos: 0.

Patterns: (1) agent systems are reducing work before model reasoning, through tool routing and sparse evidence admission; (2) coding-model releases increasingly publish the scaffold, harness, and evaluation protocol alongside weights; (3) local inference remains a fast-moving compatibility surface, with llama.cpp producing frequent attestable artifacts; (4) safety behavior continues to fork at the derivative-artifact layer.

Lead thesis: the next useful efficiency gains are arriving before and around model inference, not only inside the model. AgentWeave and SparseRead are concrete research artifacts that narrow the tool/evidence surface before reasoning, while Ornith-1.0 makes the scaffold part of the released coding-model proposition. Disconfirmation: all three are early or vendor/project-reported; AgentWeave's absolute success remains low, SparseRead's headline reductions are paper claims, and Ornith's benchmarks depend on named harnesses and settings. The defensible claim is that they change what should be measured, not that universal savings or quality gains are proven.

Promoted: Ornith-1.0 model family (current model-card release; primary/vendor claim); AgentWeave arXiv:2608.23078 (submitted Aug 24; primary paper); SparseRead arXiv:2608.22237 (submitted Aug 23; primary paper); llama.cpp b10631/b10620 release surface (primary GitHub artifacts). Watchlisted: NVIDIA RTX Spark personal-agent hardware (official but discovered late and announcement date is not established here); GitHub Copilot default model availability policy (current operational change, direct changelog retrieval incomplete); Muse Glimmer quantized GGUF (important but already covered Aug 21–25).

Excluded as repeated without a concrete delta: Qwen3.8-27B launch, Muse Glimmer launch, OpenAI Codex app-server migration, generic MCP/harness themes, generic abliterated-model commentary, and prior scheduler/power papers. Excluded as late-discovered corroboration: older model and serving reports without a new release or independent result. Missing-date gap: August 4 lacks an exact raw/canonical pair in the parent inventory.
Ornith-1.0-9B model card: https://huggingface.co/deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-9B (primary; release wording and benchmark claims are project claims).
llama.cpp releases: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases (primary GitHub release page; b10620 released Aug 25, b10631 is the current page head).
Muse Glimmer quantized artifact: https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF (primary derivative card; excluded from Top Signals as repeated).
